narrative.human_title: Latest Edition How-to-Play: the ground line teaches the game
narrative.why_it_matters: The 1996 How-to-Play book used Pikachu and Jigglypuff to make the card game approachable. Two years later, the Latest Edition uses Diglett and Dugtrio, which feels wonderfully practical: a tiny basic Pokemon and its three-headed evolution, one artist, one rule-learning object. It is less mascot sparkle and more apparatus. This is Pokemon learning how to explain evolution, stages, and play through a humble little line that later resurfaces in Pokemon Web's e-Card world.

narrative.human_title: Asobikata Diglett — the small door into the lesson
narrative.why_it_matters: Diglett is almost comically modest, which is why it works. In this book-promo lane, it is not trying to be a mascot or trophy.
